sonnetLines: Like dust upon the summer breeze.
Find the song that lights the day,
Do not fear the turning tide,
In your own rhythm, gently ride,
A path you haven't conquered yet.
The weight upon your weary soul.
Find a quiet and resting place,
Just breathe out what you cannot keep,
And watch your true self wake from sleep.
